mapper.select: SELECT WIDT.INV_QTY , WIDT.CMS_CATLG_ID, PODT.PROCESS_TYPE, PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{IK_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = WIDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.PROCESS_TYPE IN ('1','3') AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'

SELECT MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = WIDT.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, MAX(WIDT.INV_DATE) AS IK_DATE, MAX((SELECT MAX(RD_DATE) FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS RD_DATE, MAX((SELECT MAX(PO_CREATE_DATE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, MAX(DECODE((SELECT MAX(DOC_TYPE) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND STATUS <> 'D'),'S','선입고','X','Kepmro','일반')) AS DOC_TEXT, MAX((SELECT MAX(DELY_TO_LOCATION) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE AS WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER
FROM WMSIVDT WIDT WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{st_ik_no} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE, WIDT.BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO

SELECT /*selectMasterWmDlDlvryConfirmList*/ MAX((SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = WIDT.BUYER)) AS BUYER_NAME, WIDT.INV_NO AS IK_NO, COUNT(WIDT.INV_SEQ) AS CNT, SUM(WIDT.UNIT_AMT) AS UNIT_AMT, MAX((SELECT MAX(DELY_TO_LOCATION) FROM ICOMPOHD WHERE BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND STATUS <> 'D')) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, WIDT.BUYER, MAX(WIDT.INV_DATE) AS INV_DATE, DECODE(COUNT(DISTINCT WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE),1,DECODE(MAX(WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE),'1','재고','2','TR','3','VMI'),'통합') PROCESS_TYPE, DECODE(COUNT(DISTINCT WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE),1,MAX(WIDT.PROCESS_TYPE),'ALL') PROCESS_TYPE_t, MAX(WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_CD, F_GET_CMCD_NAME('C019', MAX(WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY)) AS DELIVERY_COMPANY_NM, MAX(WIDT.DELIVERY_NO) AS DELIVERY_NO, MAX(WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN) AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN, DECODE(MAX(WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN),'',2,3) AS IMAGE_KEY_SIGN_IMG, MAX(WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_INV) AS IMAGE_KEY_INV, DECODE(MAX(WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_INV),'',2,3) AS IMAGE_KEY_INV_IMG, NVL(MAX(BUYER.AUTO_GR_FLAG), 'N') AS AUTO_GR_FLAG, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BNTSLGIMP WHERE SLG_ID = 'P07-0000031' AND COM_CODE = #{st_buyer_code} AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN OPEN_DATE AND CLOSE_DATE), 0, 'N', 'Y' ) AS DLVR_ATCH_FLAG, 'N' AS EXE_GR_FLAG FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, KEP_BUYER_FLAG BUYER WHERE WIDT.BUYER = BUYER.COM_CODE(+) AND WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE =#{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.INV_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND (WIDT.BUYER LIKE '#%' OR WIDT.BUYER = 'KRXPV00001')
AND WIDT.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
AND WIDT.INV_NO LIKE #{st_ivk_no}||'%'
AND WIDT.INV_NO IN
#{st_ivk_no_barcode}
AND (WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY NOT IN ('CENTER', 'JIKNAB') OR TRIM(WIDT.DELIVERY_COMPANY) IS NULL) AND TRIM(WIDT.DELIVERY_NO) IS NULL
AND WIDT.INV_QTY <> NVL(WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY,0) AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' GROUP BY WIDT.BUYER,WIDT.INV_NO
ORDER BY 6,1,2
ORDER BY 1,2,6
ORDER BY 2,1,6
mapper.update: /*insertMasterWmDlDlvryConfirm1*/ UPDATE WMSIVDT WIDT SET WIDT.STATUS = 'R', WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE = #{st_delivery_date}, WIDT.DELIVERY_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = NVL(WIDT.INV_QTY,0), WIDT.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), WIDT.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS'), WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_INV = #{IMAGE_KEY_INV}, WIDT.IMAGE_KEY_SIGN = #{IMAGE_KEY_SIGN}, WIDT.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID = #{st_user_id}, WIDT.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{IK_NO} AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.DELIVERY_QTY = 0 AND WIDT.DELIVERY_DATE IS NULL

/*insertMasterWmDlDlvryConfirm2*/ UPDATE ICOMIVDT A SET A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS'), A.GR_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.INV_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0), A.DELIVERY_QTY = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN NVL((SELECT SUM(NVL(B.DELIVERY_QTY,0)) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE =#{st_warehouse_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.INV_NO = B.S_INV_NO AND A.INV_SEQ = B.S_INV_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) ELSE A.DELIVERY_QTY END, A.DELIVERY_DATE = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') ELSE A.DELIVERY_DATE END, A.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN #{st_user_id} ELSE A.DELIVERY_ADD_USER_ID END, A.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE = CASE WHEN (SELECT PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO=A.PO_NO AND PO_SEQ = A.PO_SEQ) IN ('1','3') THEN SYSDATE ELSE A.DELIVERY_ADD_DATE END WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND (A.INV_NO,A.INV_SEQ) IN (SELECT S_INV_NO, S_INV_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND BUYER = #{BUYER} AND INV_NO = #{IK_NO} AND STATUS <> 'D')

/*insertMasterWmDlDlvryConfirm3*/ UPDATE ICOMPODT A SET A.CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), A.CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MMSS'), A.DI_QTY = NVL((SELECT SUM(B.DELIVERY_QTY) FROM WMSIVDT B WHERE B.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS <> 'D'),0) WHERE A.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND (A.PO_NO,A.PO_SEQ) IN (SELECT PO_NO, PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WHERE WAREHOUSE_CODE =#{st_warehouse_code} AND BUYER = #{BUYER} AND INV_NO = #{IK_NO} AND STATUS <> 'D')
mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmDlWmsGrQtyCheck*/ SELECT (#{KEY_INV_QTY} + NVL(GR_QTY,0)) - NVL(ITEM_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY FROM ( SELECT NVL(B.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY -- 기입고수량 , B.ITEM_QTY , DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',NVL(C.INV_QTY,0),NVL(D.INV_QTY,0)) AS INV_QTY -- 송장수량 FROM ICOMPODT B, ICOMIVDT C, WMSIVDT D WHERE B.BUYER = #{KEY_BUYER} AND B.PO_NO = #{KEY_PO_NO} AND B.PO_SEQ = #{KEY_PO_SEQ} AND DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',C.INV_NO,D.INV_NO) = #{KEY_INV_NO} AND DECODE(B.PROCESS_TYPE,'0',C.INV_SEQ,D.INV_SEQ) = #{KEY_INV_SEQ} AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND C.INV_NO = D.S_INV_NO(+) AND C.INV_SEQ = D.S_INV_SEQ(+) AND D.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' ) S

/*selectMasterWmDlWmsGrQtyList*/ SELECT WIDT.BUYER AS KEY_BUYER, WIDT.INV_NO AS KEY_INV_NO, TO_CHAR(WIDT.INV_SEQ) AS KEY_INV_SEQ, TO_CHAR(WIDT.INV_QTY) AS KEY_INV_QTY, WIDT.PO_NO AS KEY_PO_NO, TO_CHAR(WIDT.PO_SEQ) AS KEY_PO_SEQ FROM WMSIVDT WIDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE WIDT.WAREHOUSE_CODE = #{st_warehouse_code} AND WIDT.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND WIDT.INV_NO = #{IK_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = WIDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = WIDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = WIDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND WIDT.STATUS <> 'D'
mapper.update: /*insertMasterWmDlWmsWarhsngProcGrdt*/ INSERT INTO ICOMGRDT( BUYER , GR_NO , GR_SEQ , STATUS , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CONFIRM_DATE , CONFIRM_TIME , SELLER , GR_DATE , PAY_TERMS , USANCE_DAYS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , SELLER_ITEM_NO , DESCRIPTION , SPECIFICATION , CUR , UNIT_MEASURE , ITEM_QTY , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_AMT , INV_NO , INV_SEQ , PO_NO , PO_SEQ , DO_NO , DO_SEQ , EXCHANGE_RATE , GR_LOC_AMT , LC_NO , AP_NO , PROCESS_TYPE , RO_QTY , ADD_USER_ID , NOTIFY , PAYER , PAYEE , GR_BAL_QTY , AGENT , AGENT_PRICE , CLOSE_DATE , CHANGE_USER_ID , AGENT_ITEM_AMT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , BYIT_COMORG_CODE ) ( SELECT B.BUYER , #{GR_NO} , TO_CHAR( #{GR_SEQ}, 'FM000000') , 'C' , ' ' , ' ' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') , ' ' , ' ' , B.SELLER , #{GR_DATE} , A.PAY_TERMS , A.USANCE_DAYS , B.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.SELLER_ITEM_NO , B.DESCRIPTION , B.SPECIFICATION , A.CUR , B.UNIT_MEASURE , #{GR_QTY} , B.UNIT_PRICE , ROUND(B.UNIT_PRICE * #{GR_QTY}) , C.INV_NO , C.INV_SEQ , B.PO_NO , B.PO_SEQ , '' , '' , '12' , '1' , B.LC_NO , '' , A.PROCESS_TYPE , '0' , 'FTP' , A.NOTIFY , A.PAYER , A.PAYEE , #{GR_QTY} , A.AGENT , B.AGENT_PRICE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , 'FTP' , ROUND(B.AGENT_PRICE * #{GR_QTY}) , B.LEGACY_PO_NO , B.LEGACY_PO_SEQ , B.BYIT_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMPOHD A, ICOMPODT B, WMSIVDT C WHERE B.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND B.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND B.PO_SEQ = #{PO_SEQ} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = #{BUYER} AND C.INV_NO = #{INV_NO} AND C.INV_SEQ = #{INV_SEQ} AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' )
